A simple music app using YouTube Music for backend 

SimpMusic is an open source project to stream music from YouTube and YouTube Music without ads and tracking. SimpMusic provides many features:

 - Streaming music 
 - Synced lyrics
 - Personalize data
 - etc… 

SimpMusic is always free and no ads

Build with ❤️ from Tuan Minh Nguyen Duc (maxrave-dev)

Place the music in a room, hall or plate
Each preset is a synthetic room generated from three numbers and matched in loudness, so switching rooms changes the space, not the volume.
Small and tight. Adds a sense of space without smearing the sound.
A concert hall. Long but clear, the classic slowed-and-reverb sound.
A studio plate. No gap before the reverb, bright and dense, sits well on vocals.
A cathedral. Very long and dark, the sound dissolves into the space.
RT60 is how long the tail takes to fade by 60 dB: how big the room feels.
Pre-delay is the silence before the reverb starts. A longer gap keeps the dry sound clear and pushes the walls further away.
Damping is where the tail starts losing treble. It darkens further as it decays, the way air and soft surfaces absorb highs.
Mix is the wet share: the slider sets how much of the room you hear against the dry signal, identically on Android and Desktop.
